title.zh: 【Celsius 前 CEO Alex Mashinsky 被永久禁入证券及加密行业】
title.en: 【Celsius 前 CEO Alex Mashinsky 被永久禁入证券及加密行业】

current_state.zh: New York Attorney General Letitia James reached a settlement with former Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky that permanently bans him from the securities, commodities and crypto industries and requires him to pay up to $35 million on top of federal forfeitures.
current_state.en: New York Attorney General Letitia James reached a settlement with former Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky that permanently bans him from the securities, commodities and crypto industries and requires him to pay up to $35 million on top of federal forfeitures.
